label: Week 35, 2026
recap:
This week was mostly about California, with 14 bill movements there and 3 in the United States Congress, across 2 jurisdictions. Privacy and data and transparency and disclosure each appeared 4 times, followed by health care at 2. Deepfakes and likeness, employment and hiring, government use, and workforce and education each appeared once, and 3 bills carried no theme.

The week was quiet on the federal side, with no agency documents. There were 17 bill movements and 12 case updates. A bill movement means a bill's record changed status, not that it passed.
